# Add Persistent Beginner-Fix Explanations

## Goal
Ensure all future AXEL chats include a concise beginner-friendly teaching note after each implemented fix, using exactly 3 short bullets: `Cause`, `Fix`, and `What to learn`.

## Planned Changes
- Update governance rule at [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\rules\axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\rules\axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc) to add a new always-on requirement:
  - After problem fixes, explain in simple beginner coding terms (no metaphors).
  - Keep explanation concise.
  - Use the fixed 3-bullet format (`Cause`, `Fix`, `What to learn`) for consistency across chats.
- Mirror the same requirement in canonical docs at [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_DOCS.md](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_DOCS.md) under workflow requirements/checklist so the behavior persists even if rule/docs are read separately.
- Append an implementation entry to [c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_CHANGELOG.md](c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_CHANGELOG.md) documenting:
  - request,
  - governance/doc updates,
  - persistence impact on future chats.

## Validation
- Re-read both governance/doc files and verify matching language (no contradictions).
- Confirm the rule is framed as always-on behavior for future chats.
- Ensure phrasing explicitly says beginner terms, no metaphors, concise output, and 3-bullet structure.

## Notes
- No canon conflict expected (this extends workflow guidance and does not alter gameplay/style invariants).
- This is a governance-only change; no runtime/gameplay code impact.
